title: Remove diagnostics reconstruction from frame loop
summary: Moved full Gestalt/design inspection and live diagnostics DOM updates off the requestAnimationFrame cadence. Progress-only playback publishes at a bounded 100 ms interval, while phase, ownership, diagnostics, authoring, accessibility, style, pause, seek, and completion changes remain immediate. The frame harness now gates diagnostic and inspection publish counts; constrained p95 improved from 50.1 ms to 34.2 ms and frames from 112 to 130.
